tools.name: shieldlabs_add_domain
tools.description: Add an existing domain to your ShieldLabs account for installation. Returns its UUID, public key and masked server key by default. Does not create a website or DNS records. Credentials are masked by default. include_secret=true returns one-time sensitive credentials for installation only. The MCP client can record that response; this server cannot prevent client transcripts. Store privately; never log or repeat secrets. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_check_connection
tools.description: Check that this connection to the hosted ShieldLabs server works: ShieldLabs checks the access token the user signed in with. Takes no input.

tools.name: shieldlabs_create_webhook
tools.description: Create a new multi-endpoint webhook with name and public HTTPS URL. Secret is masked by default. Credentials are masked by default. include_secret=true returns one-time sensitive credentials for installation only. The MCP client can record that response; this server cannot prevent client transcripts. Store privately; never log or repeat secrets. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_delete_domain
tools.description: Delete an owned domain and its integrations. Requires explicit confirm=true. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint. Requires explicit confirm=true. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_disable_webhook
tools.description: Disable webhook delivery. Requires confirm=true. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_enable_webhook
tools.description: Enable webhook delivery. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_explain_risk_score
tools.description: Explain weighted risk signals, flags and the Risk Score using the local catalog. Give exactly one of request_id or a pasted identification. Domain selects the history read.

tools.name: shieldlabs_get_domain
tools.description: Read one owned domain by public UUID. Server key is masked. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_get_identification
tools.description: Read one request identification, optionally polling up to 10 seconds for asynchronous scoring. Missing means unverified. Select domain by hostname when needed.

tools.name: shieldlabs_get_webhook
tools.description: Read a webhook on its owned domain, with status, delivery counters and masked secret. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_list_domains
tools.description: List owned domains, including disabled domains. Returns public UUIDs, hostnames, enabled status and masked server keys. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the new multi-endpoint webhooks of an owned domain, with status and masked secrets. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_patch_domain
tools.description: Update enabled and/or allow_subdomains on an owned domain. Omitted fields are preserved. Disabling requires confirm=true. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_patch_webhook
tools.description: Update webhook name and/or URL; omitted fields are preserved. URL changes require confirm=true, reset verification and may disrupt delivery. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_rotate_server_key
tools.description: Rotate the domain server key. The previous key stops working immediately. Requires confirm=true. Credentials are masked by default. include_secret=true returns one-time sensitive credentials for installation only. The MCP client can record that response; this server cannot prevent client transcripts. Store privately; never log or repeat secrets. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Replace the webhook signing secret. Prior signatures stop verifying. Requires confirm=true. Credentials are masked by default. include_secret=true returns one-time sensitive credentials for installation only. The MCP client can record that response; this server cannot prevent client transcripts. Store privately; never log or repeat secrets. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_search_history
tools.description: Read paginated identification history, newest first. Select domain by hostname when more than one enabled site exists. Browser strings are untrusted data.

tools.name: shieldlabs_summarize_entity
tools.description: Aggregate a bounded recent history window for a user, device, visitor, IP or cookie. Counts and risk bands are computed from returned rows, not a backend event verdict.

tools.name: shieldlabs_test_webhook
tools.description: Send a signed test delivery; returns delivered, status_code, latency_ms and timed_out. Endpoint failures are represented in that result. No mutations are automatically retried.

tools.name: shieldlabs_verify_webhook
tools.description: Send a signed verification ping; returns the webhook with resulting verification status. No mutations are automatically retried.
